title: Cross-Bond Panel Learning for Next-Day Price Forecasting of Chinese Convertible Bonds: A Reality Check
abstract: arXiv:2610.33453v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in financial machine learning have prompted growing interest in applying deep neural networks to convertible bond valuation and forecasting. However, existing studies often focus on in-sample valuation fit or cross-sectional return rankings, leaving out-of-sample next-day price forecasting insufficiently benchmarked against persistence. This paper provides a comprehensive empirical reality check on cross-bond panel learning for Chinese convertible bonds. Using a daily panel of 73,806 observations across 100 A-share convertible bonds from 2022 to 2025, we evaluate whether cross-bond neural architectures reliably outperform the random walk under strict temporal splitting, boundary purging, fold-specific preprocessing, and dependence-aware inference. On the 29,514-observation holdout, the random walk achieves an RMSE of 2.3577 CNY. Five-seed ensembles of small and large price-change MLPs yield RMSEs of 2.3619 and 2.3645 CNY,

translated_title: 跨债券面板学习用于中国可转债次日价格预测：一项现实检验
translated_abstract: 金融机器学习的最新进展引发了将深度神经网络应用于可转债估值与预测的日益浓厚的兴趣。然而，现有研究往往侧重于样本内估值拟合或横截面收益率排序，使得样本外次日价格预测缺乏与持续性基准（随机游走）的充分对比。本文对中国可转债的跨债券面板学习进行了全面的实证现实检验。使用2022年至2025年间100只A股可转债共73,806个观测值的日度面板数据，我们在严格的时间划分、边界剔除、各折独立预处理以及考虑数据依赖性的统计推断条件下，评估跨债券神经网络架构是否能可靠地超越随机游走模型。在包含29,514个观测值的留出测试集上，随机游走模型实现了2.3577元人民币的均方根误差（RMSE）。基于五个随机种子的小型与大型价格变化多层感知器（MLP）集成模型则分别取得2.3619和2.3645元人民币的RMSE，
tldr: 本文对中国可转债的跨债券神经网络面板学习进行了严格的方法论检验，发现在严格的样本外评估条件下，神经网络集成模型未能可靠超越随机游走基准，为该领域过于乐观的研究结论提供了现实警示。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a rigorous empirical reality check showing that cross-bond neural network panel learning for Chinese convertible bonds fails to reliably outperform the random walk benchmark under strict out-of-sample evaluation, cautioning against overly optimistic claims in the literature.
